styleGuide: FORME Exercise Video Style Guide v1.0

metadata.codec_long: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

preparation.colour: Source-specific secondary HSL: cyan/green, magenta and yellow reduced; mild contrast/shadow balance, no synthetic background or movement.

compression.reference: Lossless FFV1 after all crop/grade, same 120 frames, frames normalized with settb=1/24,setpts=N before SSIM.
compression.vmaf: Unavailable: installed FFmpeg has no libvmaf filter.

review.movement: One complete descent/press visible; no speed changes, reverse playback or generated frames. End includes a turn, not a clean held support. Not independent trainer certification.
review.visual: Rejected: background remains busy, bright frame/window compete with athlete, crop and rear view do not produce a convincing match to the photograph.
review.catalogue: NOT registered in data.js or service worker. Main app retains the previously published legacy clip.

comparison.panels: Unchanged AI photo; actual published video64 frames at 0.75/3s; rejected video65 study frames at 0/2.25s. Fit/letterbox only, no anatomy generation. Each panel retains its own licence.
